lines.zh: 我一跳一跳在石砖上走。
lines.en: I hop across the flagstones.
On landing, my body wobbles.
I drag a thin layer of gel.

lines.zh: 我顺着台阶一级一级弹下去。
lines.en: I bounce down the steps one at a time.

lines.zh: 我的身子一压扁，又一鼓。
lines.en: I flatten, then swell again.
I bounce a few times down the corridor.
A trail of slime stays behind.

lines.zh: 每次落地，我都压住地砖。
lines.en: Every landing, I press the tiles down.
I squeeze through the door gap.
Gel slides off my body.
I bounce forward in bursts.

lines.zh: 我看着前面的墙角，跳过去。
lines.en: I spot the corner ahead and hop to it.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在火光里一涨一落。
lines.en: My outline swells and sinks in the torchlight.
I hop along the wall to save effort.
Seven or eight hops and I rest.

lines.zh: 我跳到火把照不到的地方。
lines.en: I hop into the dark beyond the torch.
I slowly pulse on the floor.
My surface reflects the torchlight.

lines.zh: 我趴在墙角，等着谁经过。
lines.en: I lie in the corner, waiting for someone to pass.
I wait for something to walk past.

lines.zh: 我的身体一点声音也没有。
lines.en: My body makes no sound.

lines.zh: 胶在我脚下积成一小滩。
lines.en: Gel pools a little beneath me.
I quiver once, then still.
This corridor is dark and quiet.

lines.zh: 我听见有水从砖缝滴下来。
lines.en: I hear water dripping between bricks.
I lean slowly toward the light.

lines.zh: 地上的灰粘在我的皮上。
lines.en: The dust on the floor sticks to me.

lines.zh: 我压着身下的灰，一动不动。
lines.en: I press the dust beneath me and hold still.
Your soles are sticky now; that is mine.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，比刚才大一点。
lines.en: I swell a little larger.
Don't rush off; the floor is still slick.

lines.zh: 你一进门，我就闻到灰了。
lines.en: The moment you came in, I smelled the dust.
I am not quick, and I do not fear pain.
I bounce once and you step back.
This corridor is mine.
The thing on your belt is swaying.

lines.zh: 你走过去的时候，我会跟着。
lines.en: When you walk past, I will follow.

lines.zh: 你的靴子很干净，马上就脏了。
lines.en: Your boots are clean; not for long.
I am cut open and close again.
I flatten and spring back.
It hurts, though I have no bones.
My gel splatters out.
I retreat two hops.
You strike quickly; I cannot keep up.
I quiver on the floor a while.

lines.zh: 我的胶少了一捧，还能补。
lines.en: I lost a handful of gel; it will grow back.
I slowly swell back.
Come again; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 那点甜的味道，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell something sweet.
I hop once toward it.
Lower it.
It is bigger than me; perfect.
Gel wraps things up.

lines.zh: 我把它慢慢泡进身体里。
lines.en: I soak it slowly into my body.
I have wrapped it up.
Do you have another piece?

lines.zh: 这味道留在我的胶里了。
lines.en: The taste stays in my gel.
Good; I am full.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，胶沾了你一身。
lines.en: You hit me and gel smears over you.

lines.zh: 我这一弹，把你顶得偏了。
lines.en: My bounce knocks you off balance.
That flattened me a little.
I am far softer than you.
My gel sticks to your sole.
We collide and you are stuck.

lines.zh: 我慢慢恢复原来的形状。
lines.en: I slowly return to shape.

lines.zh: 你的脚抬起来，拉出一条丝。
lines.en: You lift your foot and a thread stretches.
After the bump I am still here.
Do not stand in my gel.
Bump me again; I will not scatter.
I gurgle once and shift forward.
You squeezed a dent into me.
Good; I am swollen again.
Slimes do not speak of that.
We split; we do not pair.
I am only a lump of gel.

lines.zh: 我这团胶里没有那种东西。
lines.en: There is no such thing inside this lump of gel.

lines.zh: 我只会在原地慢慢涨回去。
lines.en: I can only swell back in place, slowly.
I am the only one in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我的身体里没有那种东西。
lines.en: There is none of that inside me.
I draw myself in.
That subject is too solid for me.
Let me just keep bouncing.
I wrap my body around it.
It sinks into my gel.

lines.zh: 它慢慢化了，我尝到味道。
lines.en: It dissolves and I taste it.
Too hard; I cannot wrap it.

lines.zh: 我用身体围住它，慢慢收。
lines.en: I close my body around it and draw tight.

lines.zh: 我的胶里多了一个亮点。
lines.en: A bright spot appears in my gel.
It slips out; I wrap it again.
This is stuck in the middle of me.
I hop along with it.
Good; digested.
Footsteps, quite near.
I turn and my skin quivers.
My gel leans that way.
There is only me in this corridor.
I begin hopping that way.
You have been crowded into the corner.
I swell larger than before.

lines.zh: 你踩过的地砖还有你的味道。
lines.en: The stones you crossed still smell of you.
I hop across, one after another.

lines.zh: 你的脚步撞在墙上，传回来了。
lines.en: Your steps bounce off the wall and come back to me.

lines.zh: 你每拐一个弯，我就落一次。
lines.en: Each time you round a bend, I land once.
You round the corner; I bounce after.
My gel leaves a mark on the floor.
You look back as I swell.
I am not fast, but you will stop.
Your slime trail gives you away.
I squeeze slowly through the gap.

lines.zh: 这条长廊我弹过很多遍。
lines.en: I have bounced this corridor many times.
I follow close along the floor.
My gel is stuck to your sole.

lines.zh: 我整个扑在你的膝弯上。
lines.en: I throw my whole body at the back of your knee.
Not much force, but sticky.
Your foot is stuck to me.

lines.zh: 我压在你脚上，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I press your foot and tighten slowly.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我分成两半又合上。
lines.en: You cut me in two and I rejoin.
My gel works into your armor's seams.

lines.zh: 我的胶正贴着小腿收紧。
lines.en: My gel is tightening around your calf.
I bounce off and roll twice.
At last you shake me off.
I am still hopping behind you.

lines.zh: 我从地牢的地砖缝里渗出来。
lines.en: I seep up between the dungeon's stones.
At first I am a small pool of gel.

lines.zh: 我慢慢立起来，鼓成一团。
lines.en: I slowly rise and swell into a blob.

lines.zh: 这里不是刷怪区，可我在。
lines.en: This is not a spawn area, yet here I am.
Firelight wavers on my surface.
I begin to hop along.
There is old water on the bricks.
This corridor is new to me.
I spread my gel a little.
Good; let me find something to eat.
The heat dries my gel.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下去，摊了一地。
lines.en: I fall from the steps and spread out.
Water washes a layer off me.
The blast blows me into pieces.

lines.zh: 箭戳穿了我的胶，没碰到核。
lines.en: The arrow pierced my gel but missed my core.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的胶发硬。
lines.en: That force makes my gel stiffen.

lines.zh: 什么都没吃到，我越来越小。
lines.en: Nothing eaten; I grow smaller.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整团都在颤。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole blob trembles.
I spread out and fall away in a sheet.
